ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels to 30% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white field across both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form solid contiguous bands along the superior trailing edges and concentrated mottled clusters at the proximal junction (notch area). Linear low-intensity streaks are distributed asymmetrically across both white lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 45 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks ranging from 2-10 pixels. Significant jagged irregularities and 'chunking' visible on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a strong convex sweep from the proximal base to the lateral tips, with a secondary concave curve leading into the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, three-dimensional textured clusters (dark and light pixel aggregates) located on the distal-lateral tips of both lobes, suggesting calcified surface attachments.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, roughly parallel and non-parallel linear low-intensity pixel disruptions (scratches) predominantly oriented in vertical-to-diagonal trajectories across the high-intensity white lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake-mark scarring across both lobes; irregular topographical growths (barnacle clusters) on the lateral lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific high-contrast, circular low-intensity spot is visible on the upper margin of the left lobe, distinct from the linear streaks.
